gloss: business world; economic circles; financial community

definitions.gloss: business world; economic circles; financial community
definitions.explanation: The collective sphere of business leaders, corporations, and economic institutions, especially as they influence policy and public discourse.

examples.japanese: {経済界|けいざいかい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Criticism arose from the business community.

examples.japanese: {経済界|けいざいかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦{提言|ていげん}→提言：17132_teigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Leaders of the business world made policy proposals.

examples.japanese: {新|しん}⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧、{経済界|けいざいかい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{概|おおむ}ね→概ね：05732_oomune⟧{好意的|こういてき}な⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}した→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: The business community showed a generally favorable reaction to the new prime minister's policies.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧ (economy) + ⟦{界|かい}→界：09651_kai⟧ (world, sphere). Frequently appears in news reporting about the relationship between business and government. In Japan, {経済界|けいざいかい} often refers specifically to the major business federations such as {経団連|けいだんれん} (Keidanren) and their influence on policy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経済界|けいざいかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重鎮|じゅうちん} — heavyweight of the business world
- {経済界|けいざいかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧ — reaction from the business community
- {経済界|けいざいかい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧ — the business world and political world
- {経済界|けいざいかい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{要望|ようぼう}→要望：14111_youbou⟧ — demands from the business community

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{財界|ざいかい}→財界：22340_zaikai⟧ — financial world, business circles; largely synonymous but slightly more emphasis on major corporate and financial leaders
- {実業界|じつぎょうかい} — industrial world; more focused on actual industry and manufacturing
- ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧ — political world; the political counterpart to {経済界|けいざいかい}
